Elena (partnerships): Heads-up: Platform team plans to remove the /v1/compat-proxy route used by several partners to translate SDK calls. Need partner outreach + gating plan. Target removal date: 2026-05-15.
Rajat (platform): Thanks. Migration path idea: 1) expose new /v1/generate + header mapping; 2) marketplace compatibility shim (optional); 3) partner-specific feature-flag for canary. We can automate rewrites for a window.
Maya (integrations): Which SDKs are impacted? Marketplace listings + our hardware partners' preinstalled SDKs. I can inventory but need the exact header/param diffs to include in partner docs.
Sam (eng): Quick technical note: compat-proxy had special KV-cache prefixing. New route preserves semantics but uses different query param names (we're removing `compat=true`). We'll ship a gateway rewrite that transparently maps old calls for a transition period.
Elena (partnerships): Good. Let's also prepare an official partner email, migration guide, and a rollback playbook if the cut causes client errors.
Rajat (platform): Proposed schedule: announce 2026-04-01, start transparent gateway rewrites 2026-04-15, partner-only canary 2026-04-22, full shim removal 2026-05-15. Any blockers?
Maya (integrations): Schedule OK. I'll coordinate the marketplace partners and HW OEMs. Recommend offering two migration paths: (A) quick SDK patch (minor) or (B) opt-in marketplace-hosted shim for partners who need more time.
Sam (eng): Example migration snippet partners can use:
```bash
# old
curl -H "X-Compat-Proxy: true" https://api.redwood.com/v1/compat-proxy/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
# new
curl -H "X-RW-SDK-Mode: legacy" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
We'll produce patches for python/js/go and a small compatibility client.
Elena (partnerships): I'll draft the partner email + tracking spreadsheet. Maya — can you add partner priority (who needs hand-holding)?
Maya (integrations): Adding now. Pinged Michael from AcmeHW for the early canary slot.
VendorBot: Reminder: create Jira epic RW-PLT-523 for compatibility shim + partner outreach.
Sam (eng): Also raise to eng-sre: KV cache semantics differ; add smoke tests in release pipeline for affected paths.
Rajat (platform): I'll own the canary dashboard and the rollback toggle. Suggest auto-fallback to legacy route if a partner sees >10 errors/min during canary.
Elena (partnerships): Great. Next check-in Tue 2026-03-30 09:30 PT. Notes & tasks -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-PLT-523 :thumbsup:
Maya (integrations): :thumbsup:
Sam (eng): lgtm
Rajat (platform): lgtm
